slides.headline: OPENAI BUILT AN AI SECURITY RESEARCHER
slides.body: It autonomously finds, validates, and helps fix software vulnerabilities.
sides: OpenAI officially introduced Aardvark, an autonomous security research agent.
Security scanning is shifting from passive static analysis to autonomous action.

slides.headline: MEET AARDVARK
slides.body: Traditional scanners only flag potential flaws. OpenAI's new system handles the entire security workflow autonomously.
sides: Aardvark is currently entering private beta testing.
Autonomous software defense is becoming an active capability.
